requirements.statement: Every criterion the Judge rules not met carries exactly one kind (build-defect, evidence-gap or not-checkable-here), recorded in verification-state.json and shown in verification-report.md. Must pass.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives O1; investigation Objectives O1

requirements.statement: Only build-defect criteria are handed to the Debug stage; an iteration with no build defect dispatches no Debug agent. Must pass.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives O2; investigation Objectives O2

requirements.statement: An evidence-gap criterion gets exactly one re-capture per run; if still an evidence gap it settles as a definition problem and counts toward neither the stalled nor the cap rule. Must pass.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives O3; investigation Objectives O3

requirements.statement: A not-checkable-here result is settled once with its reason and is not re-opened by a later invocation (resume or /verify-build fix round) unless verification.md changed since it was recorded. Must pass.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives O4; investigation Objectives O4

requirements.statement: Not-checkable results knowable before exercising (parts-only design board structure row; design-structure row on a production/minified environment) are classified at preflight and never handed to Exercise. Acceptance is not a must pass.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives O5; investigation Objectives O5

requirements.statement: The setup check tolerates a dev server cold start: warm-up request and generous first-response timeout before a target's reach is recorded as failed.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives O6; investigation Objectives O6

requirements.statement: /verify-build fix rounds and /refine-verification read the recorded kind instead of re-deriving buildability from the cause, falling back to cause only for a state file written before this change.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives O7; investigation Objectives O7

requirements.statement: One headless fixture run of /verify-build on a fixture seeded with one defect, one missing capture and one host-only criterion shows all three kinds in its report. Live acceptance.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives O8; investigation Objectives O8 (PM acceptance)

requirements.statement: Tests pass; unit coverage at least 60% and integration coverage at least 50% where applicable (constitution floors). Derived from constitution.md, not from the PM instruction.
Every new input is validated where it enters (two new workflow arguments, new decideNext input, two new CLI subcommands); malformed values fail loudly and are never defaulted.
Documentation updated: sibling TRDs whose decisions change carry an inline amendment marker pointing at this TRD, and the contract the Judge reads states the kind vocabulary.
State files and report inputs written before this change (no kind, settled or verificationDigest keys) still load, resume and render; a report built from an older input is unchanged.

open_questions: OQ-1 | Should a run whose only open criteria are settled evidence gaps end satisfied? | Assumed: Yes, through the existing satisfied branch, still blocked by the coverage floor and must-pass (D7). This is the investigation's OQ-1 assumption. | A satisfied banner beside definition problems may read as clean. | Add a distinct outcome. That touches every outcome reader.

OQ-2 | Is never-exercised an evidence gap? | Assumed: Yes (D2), following the investigation's OQ-2. It now re-captures once instead of reaching Debug. | It changes today's routing. | Map it back to build-defect in KIND_BY_CAUSE. The change is one table cell plus its pin.

OQ-3 | Should not-checkable-here from a temporarily unusable environment persist until verification.md changes (TR1)? | Assumed: Yes: O4's condition as written, with no extra re-open trigger. | A dev server that was down at preflight keeps its criteria set aside on later invocations. | Also re-open when section 3.6a's per-environment result for that criterion's environment changes. That would mean recording the environment name per entry.

OQ-4 | An evidence gap first seen on the cap iteration has no iteration left for its re-capture. Should it count as open at the cap? | Assumed: Yes. It is not settled (never re-captured), so the run ends stuck as today. | O3 says exactly one re-capture per run. At the cap there is no room for one. | Settle it at the cap without a re-capture. That needs a rule for re-capture impossible.

OQ-5 | Are a 60-second first-response timeout and about 90 seconds of retries generous enough? | Assumed: Yes; these are the investigation's values (D13). They are design parameters, not acceptance thresholds. | A slower cold start still ends setup-failure. | Raise the constants in buildSetupPrompt.

OQ-6 | Which verification.md copy is digested? | Assumed: The copy owner-rules.js path verification.md prints, which section 8.1a already reads (D9). | Hashing a different copy than the one the run resolved lanes from would persist results against the wrong policy. | Switch the CLI argument in section 8.1a. The CLI itself is path-agnostic.

OQ-7 | Should O8's task be [LIVE], departing from the investigation? | Assumed: Yes (D19). [LIVE] is not deferred, and the authoring contract requires it. | If /plan --implement did set [LIVE] aside, O8 would never run. | Drop the marker. The task text and its acceptance are unchanged.

OQ-8 | Should a settled evidence gap appear under ## Not Met as well as the new section? | Assumed: No. It appears only in the new section (D16), so it is not read as an open defect. | Readers of ## Not Met lose sight of it. | List it in both. This is a renderer-only change.
